name: Flash Conscription — the quoted lifegain ability is granted only if {W} was spent
notes: Sweep cast-condition leftovers (2026-10-06). 'If {W} was spent to cast this spell, the creature gains "Whenever this creature deals combat damage, you gain that much life" until end of turn.' produced nothing: the branch splitter skipped every line holding a quoted ability, and "the creature" was not read as the spell's target. Quotes are now held out of the line while it is split, and "the creature gains" resolves to the target of "Untap target creature and gain control of it". With {W} spent, Hill Giant has haste and the quoted ability; without it, Gray Ogre has haste only.

$includes: Whenever this creature deals combat damage, you gain that much life

$excludes: Whenever this creature deals combat damage, you gain that much life
